name: Dalin's Heart
summary: Dalin's Heart is a macabre ritual component carved from Dalin Forgewright, an honorable man patrolling near the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest. Undercity warlocks seek it out as an offering of unblemished purity, intended to lure and bind a succubus to their service.

sections.title: A Pure Heart for Dark Arts
sections.body: To summon and subjugate a succubus, Undercity warlocks require rare bait: the physical hearts of truly virtuous mortals. Dalin Forgewright earned his dark fate through selfless devotion, spending his days defending desperate Lordaeron refugees barred from safety at the sealed Greymane Wall. His unstinting altruism marks him as an emblem of goodness in a fallen land, making his heart an irresistible prize for demonic seduction rites conducted within the Temple of the Damned.

faq.answer: Dalin Forgewright was an honorable human who dedicated his life to protecting Lordaeron refugees stranded outside the closed gates of the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need Dalin's Heart?
aliases: why do warlocks want dalin's heart
faq.answer: Warlock summoners in the Undercity require the heart of a genuinely pure and honorable man as a ritual lure to attract and dominate a succubus.
The heart is brought to Carendin Halgar, a warlock trainer located in the Temple of the Damned within the Undercity.

faq.q: What other component is needed alongside this heart?
aliases: hearts of the pure other heart
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar requires both Dalin's Heart and Comar's Heart, belonging to Comar Villard, a faithful husband wandering the Wetlands in search of his lost wife.

angles.text: Procuring this heart is an essential rite of passage for Forsaken warlocks learning to ensnare a succubus, proving their willingness to harvest untainted virtue for demonic mastery.
The hunt for Dalin's heart highlights the bitter reality of post-Scourge Lordaeron, where remaining living human altruists outside the Greymane Wall become prey for the Forsaken.
